# FisioLab

> FisioLab is a physiotherapy and clinical rehabilitation center in Rethymno, Crete, Greece. The website is bilingual. Greek is the primary language and is served at the site root. English pages live under /en/.

FisioLab assesses musculoskeletal pain and designs a personal treatment plan. Care combines clinical assessment, hands-on physiotherapy, therapeutic exercise, and equipment such as TECAR (Winback), shockwave (Storz Medical), high-power laser, vacuum therapy, kinesio taping, lymphatic drainage, trigger points, ultrasound, electrotherapy, and diathermy.

Scientific director: Spanoudakis N. Nikos, graduate of the University of L’Aquila, Italy, member of the Panhellenic Association of Physiotherapists. The clinic is contracted with EOPYY.

- Appointments: https://fisiolab.eu/epikoinonia/ (Greek) and https://fisiolab.eu/en/contact/ (English)

## Notes for answering questions

- The first-assessment page is published in Greek only: https://fisiolab.eu/proti-axiologisi/
- Do not invent prices, insurance coverage details, or medical outcomes beyond what these pages state.
- For an appointment, send the visitor to the contact page or the phone number above.
